questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

First row - 56, 16, 60

Second row - 64, 18, 68

Third row - 72, 20, ?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. Eg. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

D _ A _ W _ S _ E W _ S A E _ D _ A E _
questions.solution:
Given series: D _ A _ W _ S _ E W _ S A E _ D _ A E _ 

Option 1) SEDADWSW → D __**S**__ A __**E**__ W __**D**__ S __**A**__ E W __**D**__ S A E __**W**__ D __**S**__ A E __**W**__ → (It follows the pattern of: DSAEW - DSAEW - DSAEW - DSAEW)

Option 2) SEDADWES → D __S__ A __E__ W __D__ S __A__ E W __D__ S A E __W__ D __E__ A E __S__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) SEDADSSW → D __S__ A __E__ W __D__ S __A__ E W __D__ S A E __S__ D __S__ A E __W__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) SEDADESW → D __S__ A __E__ W __D__ S __A__ E W __D__ S A E __E__ D __S__ A E __W__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some stars are planets.

All stars are comets.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some comets are planets.

II. Some planets are stars.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/963b76093753ad591e70b6134e0647cfde13b159fdc5bbd7ef6a983f4322284b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4acad2033580f518f60ac730efc3fa75c3bd0a49c18758f8b9c3b85fa9fff9d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some comets are planets → Follow (As some stars are planets and all stars are comets. As whole stars comes in comets and has some part common with planets, therefore it is true.)

II. Some planets are stars → Follow (As some stars are planets. As stars has some part common with planets, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62
questions.solution:
Given equation: 35 + 76 ÷ 98 × 3 – 6 = 62

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) ÷ and × **

Given: 35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 35 + 76 − 98 × 3 ÷ 6 = 62

⇒ 35 + 76 − 98 × 0.5 = 62

⇒ 35 + 76 − 49 = 62

⇒ 111 − 49 = 62

⇒ 62 = 62

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) = and × 

Given: 35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 = 6 × 62

⇒ 35 + 76 − 32.67 = 372

⇒ 111 − 32.67 = 372

⇒ 78.33 ≠ 62

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) + and × 

Given: 35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 35 × 76 − 98 ÷ 3 + 6 = 62

⇒ 35 × 76 − 32.67 + 6 = 62

⇒ 2,660 − 32.67 + 6 = 62

⇒ 2,633.33 ≠ 62

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) – and +

Given: 35 + 76 − 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62

After interchanging the signs we get;

⇒ 35 - 76 + 98 ÷ 3 × 6 = 62

⇒ 35 - 76 + 196 = 62

⇒ 231 - 76 = 62

⇒ 155 ≠ 62

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
If A denotes ‘+’, B denotes ‘×’, C denotes ‘−’, and D denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

24 D (1 A 7) C 2 A 7 B 12 B (5 C 4) = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 24 D (1 A 7) C 2 A 7 B 12 B (5 C 4) = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 +
 ×
 -
 ÷
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 24 __**÷ (1 + 7)**__ - 2 + 7 × 12 × __**(5 - 4)**__ = ?

⇒ 24 __**÷ 8**__ - 2 + **__7 × 1​2 × 1**__ = ?

⇒ __**3**__ - 2 + __**84**__ = ?

⇒ __**87 - 2 **__= **85**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2".
